data.one_liner: A horizontal scrolling picker widget to select numerical values.
data.what_it_does: Provides a horizontal scrollable picker widget allowing users to select a value within a specified minimum and maximum range, featuring customizable divisions, suffixes, and colors.
use_when: You need a horizontal selector for numerical ranges like measurements or ages.
You want a custom picker widget integrated directly into a Flutter form or UI.
avoid_when: You need date or calendar picking functionality instead of generic numerical ranges.
You require complex non-numeric selections or heavily customized multi-wheel pickers.
strengths: Simple and straightforward API for numeric range picking.
Supports custom colors, text styles, and suffixes like units of measurement.
weaknesses: Documentation and configuration options are minimal.
data.minimal_example:
HorizontalPicker(
  minValue: -10,
  maxValue: 50,
  divisions: 600,
  suffix: " cm",
  showCursor: false,
  backgroundColor: Colors.grey.shade900,
  activeItemTextColor: Colors.white,
  passiveItemsTextColor: Colors.amber,
  onChanged: (value) {},
),
